rows.reasoning: Aguiar-Curry voted Aye on SB 54 (2017-2018), the California Values Act, restricting state and local law enforcement from using resources to assist federal immigration enforcement except for a broad list of felony and specified-conviction categories. This establishes a direction toward limiting deportation cooperation but the carve-outs (e.g. any felony punishable by state prison) extend well beyond "convicted of serious violent crimes," so the record cannot establish rung 2 or any single rung's precise magnitude.
